description: Defines the LoanSecurityPledge class for managing loan security pledges, including validation, pledge amount calculation, and loan updates within a loan management system.

classes.name: LoanSecurityPledge
classes.description: Represents a pledge of loan securities, handling validation, submission, cancellation, and related calculations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the pledge, including duplicate securities and security type consistency.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the pledge is submitted, updating status and loan details.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions to perform when the pledge is canceled, reverting status and loan details.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_securities
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate securities are added to the pledge.

methods.name: validate_loan_security_type
methods.description: Validates that all securities have consistent loan-to-value ratios.

methods.name: set_pledge_amount
methods.description: Calculates total security value and maximum loan value based on securities.
